description: React component for managing and displaying a dropdown menu for channel members, including role changes and removal actions.

methods.name: handleRemoveFromChannel
methods.description: Handles removal of a user from a channel, including modal display for self-removal.

methods.name: handleMakeChannelAdmin
methods.description: Triggers role update to make a user a channel admin.

methods.name: handleMakeChannelMember
methods.description: Triggers role update to make a user a channel member.

methods.name: updateChannelMemberSchemeRole
methods.description: Updates the user's role scheme to admin or member.

methods.name: renderRole
methods.description: Returns JSX element representing the user's role label.
